name: alchemy-provider
description: Bring up a new Alchemy cloud provider (its own `@alchemy.run/<provider>` package under packages/<provider>) end to end — credentials, a distilled SDK, resources, bindings, live tests, and the patch loop that feeds live-test failures back into distilled — or extend an existing provider with a new service, or bring an existing provider up to the bar (gap audit, then waves). Use for "add a <X> provider", "create an alchemy provider for <X>", "port <X> to alchemy", "add <service> to the <X> provider
author: pingdotgg
